availability_overrides_kind_shape.name: availability_overrides_kind_shape
availability_overrides_kind_shape.value:
("availability_overrides"."kind" = 'day_off'
            AND "availability_overrides"."start_time" IS NULL
            AND "availability_overrides"."end_time" IS NULL)
          OR ("availability_overrides"."kind" = 'custom_hours'
            AND "availability_overrides"."start_time" IS NOT NULL
            AND "availability_overrides"."end_time" IS NOT NULL
            AND "availability_overrides"."start_date" = "availability_overrides"."end_date"
            AND "availability_overrides"."start_time" < "availability_overrides"."end_time")

availability_seasons_weekday_before_end.name: availability_seasons_weekday_before_end
availability_seasons_weekday_before_end.value: "availability_seasons"."weekday_start_time" IS NULL OR "availability_seasons"."weekday_end_time" IS NULL OR "availability_seasons"."weekday_start_time" < "availability_seasons"."weekday_end_time"

availability_seasons_weekend_before_end.name: availability_seasons_weekend_before_end
availability_seasons_weekend_before_end.value: "availability_seasons"."weekend_start_time" IS NULL OR "availability_seasons"."weekend_end_time" IS NULL OR "availability_seasons"."weekend_start_time" < "availability_seasons"."weekend_end_time"

booking_batches_weekly_fields_pair.name: booking_batches_weekly_fields_pair
booking_batches_weekly_fields_pair.value:
(
        ("booking_batches"."mode" = 'weekly'
         AND "booking_batches"."weekly_pattern" IS NOT NULL
         AND jsonb_typeof("booking_batches"."weekly_pattern") = 'array'
         AND jsonb_array_length("booking_batches"."weekly_pattern") >= 1
         AND "booking_batches"."weekly_start_date" IS NOT NULL
         AND "booking_batches"."weekly_weeks" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("booking_batches"."mode" = 'manual'
         AND "booking_batches"."weekly_pattern" IS NULL
         AND "booking_batches"."weekly_start_date" IS NULL
         AND "booking_batches"."weekly_weeks" IS NULL)
      )

coach_notifications_scope_valid.name: coach_notifications_scope_valid
coach_notifications_scope_valid.value:
(
        ("coach_notifications"."category" IN ('booking_request', 'request_expiring_soon', 'parent_change', 'auto_approved_summary')
         AND ((CASE WHEN "coach_notifications"."lesson_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            + (CASE WHEN "coach_notifications"."batch_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1))
        OR ("coach_notifications"."category" IN ('calendar_disconnected', 'daily_summary', 'account_deleted')
            AND "coach_notifications"."lesson_id" IS NULL AND "coach_notifications"."batch_id" IS NULL)
      )

coach_push_subscriptions_removed_reason_.name: coach_push_subscriptions_removed_reason_pair
coach_push_subscriptions_removed_reason_.value:
("coach_push_subscriptions"."is_active" = true AND "coach_push_subscriptions"."removed_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("coach_push_subscriptions"."is_active" = false)

balance_ledger_amount_sign_valid.name: balance_ledger_amount_sign_valid
balance_ledger_amount_sign_valid.value:
(
        ("household_balance_ledger"."entry_type" IN ('card_topup', 'package_purchase', 'package_bonus', 'refund_to_balance') AND "household_balance_ledger"."amount_cents" > 0)
        OR ("household_balance_ledger"."entry_type" = 'lesson_charge' AND "household_balance_ledger"."amount_cents" < 0)
        OR ("household_balance_ledger"."entry_type" = 'free_lesson' AND "household_balance_ledger"."amount_cents" = 0)
        OR ("household_balance_ledger"."entry_type" = 'coach_adjustment' AND "household_balance_ledger"."amount_cents" <> 0)
      )

balance_ledger_lesson_id_scope_valid.name: balance_ledger_lesson_id_scope_valid
balance_ledger_lesson_id_scope_valid.value:
(
        ("household_balance_ledger"."entry_type" IN ('lesson_charge', 'refund_to_balance', 'free_lesson') AND "household_balance_ledger"."lesson_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("household_balance_ledger"."entry_type" NOT IN ('lesson_charge', 'refund_to_balance', 'free_lesson') AND "household_balance_ledger"."lesson_id" IS NULL)
      )

balance_ledger_stripe_session_scope_vali.name: balance_ledger_stripe_session_scope_valid
balance_ledger_stripe_session_scope_vali.value:
(
        ("household_balance_ledger"."entry_type" IN ('card_topup', 'package_purchase', 'package_bonus') AND "household_balance_ledger"."stripe_checkout_session_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("household_balance_ledger"."entry_type" NOT IN ('card_topup', 'package_purchase', 'package_bonus') AND "household_balance_ledger"."stripe_checkout_session_id" IS NULL)
      )

balance_ledger_adjustment_reason_valid.name: balance_ledger_adjustment_reason_valid
balance_ledger_adjustment_reason_valid.value:
(
        ("household_balance_ledger"."entry_type" = 'coach_adjustment' AND "household_balance_ledger"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("household_balance_ledger"."reason")) > 0)
        OR ("household_balance_ledger"."entry_type" <> 'coach_adjustment' AND "household_balance_ledger"."reason" IS NULL)
      )

invites_not_both_revoked_and_accepted.name: invites_not_both_revoked_and_accepted
invites_not_both_revoked_and_accepted.value: NOT ("household_invites"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "household_invites"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

lesson_email_outbox_scope_exactly_one.name: lesson_email_outbox_scope_exactly_one
lesson_email_outbox_scope_exactly_one.value:
("lesson_email_outbox"."payload" ? '_scrubbed_at')
        OR ("lesson_email_outbox"."event" = 'coach_account_deleted')
        OR ((CASE WHEN "lesson_email_outbox"."lesson_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          + (CASE WHEN "lesson_email_outbox"."batch_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
          + (CASE WHEN "lesson_email_outbox"."bulk_cancellation_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1)

lesson_email_outbox_bulk_household_pair.name: lesson_email_outbox_bulk_household_pair
lesson_email_outbox_bulk_household_pair.value:
("lesson_email_outbox"."payload" ? '_scrubbed_at')
        OR ("lesson_email_outbox"."event" = 'coach_account_deleted')
        OR (("lesson_email_outbox"."bulk_cancellation_id" IS NULL) = ("lesson_email_outbox"."household_id" IS NULL))

grade_xor_no_concept.name: grade_xor_no_concept
grade_xor_no_concept.value:
("skill_ratings"."no_concept" = false AND "skill_ratings"."grade" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_ratings"."grade" >= 1 AND "skill_ratings"."grade" <= 5)
          OR ("skill_ratings"."no_concept" = true AND "skill_ratings"."grade" IS NULL)

void_fields_consistent.name: void_fields_consistent
void_fields_consistent.value:
("skill_ratings"."voided_at" IS NULL AND "skill_ratings"."void_reason" IS NULL AND "skill_ratings"."void_by" IS NULL)
          OR ("skill_ratings"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_ratings"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_ratings"."void_by" IS NOT NULL)

supersede_fields_consistent.name: supersede_fields_consistent
supersede_fields_consistent.value:
("skill_ratings"."superseded_at" IS NULL AND "skill_ratings"."superseded_by" IS NULL AND "skill_ratings"."superseded_by_rating_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("skill_ratings"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_ratings"."superseded_by" IS NOT NULL AND "skill_ratings"."superseded_by_rating_id" IS NOT NULL)

exactly_one_club.name: exactly_one_club
exactly_one_club.value: ("swimmer_clubs"."club_id" IS NOT NULL AND "swimmer_clubs"."other_club_name" IS NULL) OR ("swimmer_clubs"."club_id" IS NULL AND "swimmer_clubs"."other_club_name" IS NOT NULL)

public_consent_required.name: public_consent_required
public_consent_required.value: NOT "swimmers"."is_public" OR ("swimmers"."public_consent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "swimmers"."public_consent_by" IS NOT NULL)
